channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caiado defende petróleo na Margem Equatorial e sugere crítica à reinjeção do gás natural
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) advocated for oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin and emphasized the need to expand Brazil’s natural gas pipeline infrastructure. He also criticized the reinjection of natural gas, suggesting it is inefficient or inadequate for the country’s energy development.

item.title: Campanha do TSE voltada a jovens é finalista do 4º Prêmio Social Media Gov
item.description: The TSE's 'Voting is Our Thing' campaign, launched in November 2025, is a finalist in the 4th Social Media Gov Award for mobilizing 15- to 17-year-olds to register to vote, supported by influencers like Alok, Mítico and Igão, leading to a 12.8% increase in youth voter registration.

item.title: “Eleição se resolve no voto, não na canetada”, diz Flávio a Fachin sobre Rio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized STF Minister Cristiano Zanin’s decision to keep Ricardo Couto as acting governor of Rio de Janeiro, stating that elections should be decided by vote, not judicial rulings. He urged STF President Edson Fachin to intervene and uphold the state’s electoral process.

item.title: Ao vivo: Edinho Silva e Jilmar Tatto participam de Congresso do PT
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva and vice-president Jilmar Tatto attended the opening session of the party's 8th National Congress in Brasília, under the theme 'Sovereignty, Reconstruction and Future'. The event discussed the political landscape and electoral strategy for 2026, featuring panels on education and elections. The official opening took place at 7 PM at the Brasília 21 Convention Center.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes quer reafirmar quem governa o STF e que inexiste autoridade para investigar ministros
item.description: Gilmar Mendes defends the STF's autonomy and rejects any investigation into its ministers, arguing that inquiries into individual conduct constitute attacks on the institution. He asserts that the fake news inquiry, led by Alexandre de Moraes, is a necessary and permanent tool intended to last at least until the 2026 elections to punish politicians who criticize Supreme Court justices. Mendes positions himself as the leader of a bloc within the STF seeking to shield the Court from external scrutiny, equating political criticism with crime and denying ministers' personal accountability for private relationships.

item.title: Governo veta Kalshi e Polymarket no Brasil
item.description: Brazil's Central Bank banned the offering and trading of prediction contracts tied to political and electoral events, impacting international platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket. The CMN resolution takes effect on May 4 and aims to prevent betting on election outcomes and other sensitive events.

item.title: Nikolas chama Jair Renan, filho de Bolsonaro, de ‘toupeira cega’
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) called Jair Renan Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, a 'blind mole' in a social media exchange. The conflict began after an influencer mocked Nikolas for changing from a black to a white shirt, which he interpreted as criticism of his opposition to the Lula government. The exchange of insults is part of a broader pattern of public clashes between Nikolas and other far-right figures, including recent criticisms from Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Desaprovação de Lula se mantém em 50% no Lulômetro
item.description: President Lula's disapproval rating remained at 50% on Friday, 24, according to the Lulômetro, a daily tracking poll conducted by O Antagonista and Real Time Big Data. This marks the second consecutive day the disapproval rate reached 50%, after first hitting that level on Thursday. The government is rated as "bad/terrible" by 50%, "good/excellent" by 26%, and "fair" by 23%.

item.title: Presidente do PT defende ampliar participação da sociedade no CNJ
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of the Workers' Party (PT), advocated for increasing civil society participation in the National Council of Justice (CNJ) to bring the judiciary closer to Brazilian society, while criticizing 'penduricalhos' as unjustified privileges. He also stressed the need for political-electoral reform, praised the Lula government's economic reforms — including the Tax Reform and fiscal deficit reduction — and defended a national program for rare earth minerals as a matter of national sovereignty, accusing the Bolsonaro family of seeking to hand over such reserves to the United States.

item.title: Forças Armadas devem enviar documentos em processo sobre perda de patente de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Superior Military Tribunal has authorized the collection of documents from the Armed Forces to assess whether former President Jair Bolsonaro should lose his military rank of captain due to his conviction for attempting a coup. The process, based on the STF's ruling, examines alleged violations of military ethics and also includes other officials such as Almir Garnier and Augusto Heleno. The defense has the right to produce evidence, and the trial will proceed after the evidence-gathering phase.

item.title: Saiba quais são as 27 plataformas proibidas de operar no Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian government banned 27 predictive market platforms for violating national legislation, with Anatel initiating access blocks nationwide. These platforms allowed betting on elections, sports, and reality shows, deemed illegal as they do not fit under gambling laws, financial regulations, or derivatives frameworks. The move aims to protect users, particularly low-income individuals, from financial risks due to lack of oversight and regulation.

item.title: A estratégia da oposição para tentar ditar ritmo mais lento da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The opposition is seeking to slow the progress of the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, fearing its approval would boost Lula’s 2026 presidential prospects, particularly against Flávio Bolsonaro. Their strategy includes negotiating compensation for business owners and extending debate in the special committee to the maximum 40 sessions, though this faces opposition from Chamber President Hugo Motta, who favors a swift approval by May.

item.title: Moraes decreta prisão domiciliar de condenada pela trama golpista
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered former federal police delegate Marília Ferreira de Alencar to begin serving house arrest for her role in the 2022 coup plot’s Nucleus 2. She was sentenced to eight years and six months for preparing intelligence reports used to target PRF operations in municipalities where Lula received over 75% of the vote, aiming to suppress voter turnout. During the 2022 election period, Marília served as Intelligence Director at the Justice Ministry under Anderson Torres, later following him to the DF Public Security Secretariat.

item.title: O duro documento da Fazenda sobre o ‘mercado de previsões’ no Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian Ministry of Finance, through the Secretariat of Prizes and Bets (SPA), issued a technical note warning of risks such as manipulation, insider information use, money laundering, and terrorism financing in 'prediction markets', particularly those involving non-financial topics like elections. The document states these markets are more susceptible to illicit activities than sports betting due to weak KYC, transaction monitoring, and traceability, and that betting on electoral outcomes constitutes an electoral offense under TSE rulings, threatening democratic integrity.

item.title: PT promete passe livre e fim do Tigrinho na campanha de Lula
item.description: The Workers' Party discussed in Brasília the first version of a document proposing policy guidelines for Lula's 2026 re-election campaign, including free public transportation and restrictions on virtual gambling games like 'Tigrinho'. The draft is still subject to amendments and forms part of the PT's preparation for the upcoming election.

item.title: Congresso decide no dia 30 se mantém veto à dosimetria
item.description: The National Congress will decide on April 30 whether to uphold or overturn the presidential veto on PL 2.162/2023, which established sentencing guidelines for those involved in the January 8, 2023 attacks. President Lula vetoed the bill, arguing that reducing penalties for crimes against the democratic state would violate the Constitution and encourage further antidemocratic acts. Overturning the veto requires an absolute majority in separate votes in the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate.

item.title: Nikolas chama Jair Renan de ‘toupeira cega’ e amplia atrito com família Bolsonaro após embate com Eduardo
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) intensified his rift with the Bolsonaro family by calling councilman Jair Renan Bolsonaro a 'blind mole' in a social media exchange, following criticism from Eduardo Bolsonaro and allies over his limited engagement in Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign. Nikolas claimed he faces 'unilateral attacks' and denied avoiding support for Flávio to avoid sharing the spotlight, stating his strategy is to reach beyond the Bolsonarist base.

item.title: Motta cria comissão para analisar PEC da redução da escala 6X1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta has created a special committee to analyze two PECs aimed at reducing Brazil's workweek and ending the 6x1 schedule. The proposals include reducing weekly hours from 44 to 36 (Reginaldo Lopes) and implementing a four-day workweek with a 36-hour limit (Erika Hilton). The Lula government has also sent an urgent bill to reduce the workweek to 40 hours, seeking to preempt the PECs' lengthy process.

item.title: Trama golpista: STF encerra fase de recursos e já executou as penas de todos os condenados
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) concluded the appeals phase and ordered the execution of sentences for the 29 individuals convicted of the 2022 coup attempt led by Jair Bolsonaro. Of the convicted, 20 are in closed regime, 3 under house arrest, 3 are fugitives, 2 reached plea deals, and 1 is in open regime. Sentences range from 1 year and 11 months to 27 years and three months, including former ministers and high-ranking military officials.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes ressuscita a “terceira via” e a joga no colo de Zema
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes has revived the idea of a 'third way' in Brazilian politics, suggesting it could be directed to Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema. The proposal arises amid public criticism of Mendes for his role in the Supreme Court, particularly during the Court's credibility crisis. The author defends the need for forceful yet institutionally respectful criticism of Mendes while supporting the pursuit of political alternatives beyond current polarization.

item.title: Apostas em Flávio superam Lula no Polymarket
item.description: Following the Brazilian Central Bank's ban on predictive market operations, Polymarket data shows bets on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election dropped to 36%, while bets on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) held steady at 38%, reversing a prior trend where Lula led. The shift occurred after the CMN's Resolution No. 5.298 prohibited derivatives tied to events like elections, though international platforms remain accessible.

item.title: Propostas do PT para campanha de Lula incluem passe livre no transporte, proibição do Tigrinho e crítica ao BC
item.description: The PT is drafting a policy document for Lula's re-election campaign, featuring criticism of the Central Bank and interest rates, calls for changes to the Fiscal Responsibility Law, a ban on the 'Tigrinho' game, regulation of big techs, and implementation of free public transport. The national directory postponed the party's new program until after the 2026 elections to avoid internal divisions and prioritize Lula's victory. The document will be voted on and may be amended, but leaders expect no room for bold proposals.

item.title: Médicos recomendam que Lula retome atividades só na 2ª feira
item.description: Lula had a basal cell carcinoma removed from his scalp in surgery at the Sírio-Libanés Hospital on April 24, 2026, and was discharged the same day. His medical team advised him to resume activities only on Monday, April 27, avoiding large events and wearing a hat during healing, which is expected to take about a month. His planned attendance at the 8th PT National Congress on Sunday, April 26, has not been confirmed by Secom.

item.title: Mesmo com proibição do BC, é possível apostar em resultados eleitorais
item.description: The CMN resolution banning predictive betting on political events in Brazil does not block access to foreign platforms like Polymarket and Kalshi, which remain operational due to their crypto-based infrastructure and overseas jurisdiction. Despite the blocking of 27 domestic platforms ordered by Finance Minister Dario Durigan, the terms of service of these international platforms place the legal compliance burden on the user.

item.title: Governo bloqueia 27 plataformas que operam mercado de preditivos no Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian federal government blocked 28 predictive market platforms, including Polymarket and Kalshi, deeming them illegal under new regulations by the Central Bank and the Secretariat of Prizes and Bets (SPA) under the Ministry of Finance. These platforms allowed users to bet on real-world events such as elections, economic indicators, and cultural awards, which the government classifies as equivalent to fixed-odds betting (bets) requiring specific licensing. The measure does not affect the already-regulated sports betting market but aims to halt unauthorized financial derivatives operations in the country.

item.title: Vídeo de 'fazenda de likes' de Flávio Bolsonaro e Nikolas Ferreira é IA
item.description: Social media posts falsely claim that a police operation uncovered a 'like farm' linked to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira. The content is misinformation, with no evidence of such a discovery by authorities.

item.title: Alckmin e ministro da Agricultura vão representar governo Lula na Agrishow
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and Minister of Agriculture Carlos Fávaro will represent the Lula government at Agrishow, the agribusiness fair in Ribeirão Preto. The information was released by the Presidency's Secretariat of Social Communication.

item.title: Conselho de Ética analisa processo contra deputado bolsonarista que xingou Motta nesta terça-feira
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council will meet next Tuesday (28) to vote on the opinions regarding complaints against bolsonarist deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS), accused of insulting Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB). The allegations include slurs such as 'you piece of shit' and 'you bastard', along with remarks about Motta's physical appearance, during a protest that paralyzed the plenary for over 30 hours in August 2025. Penalties could include a 90-day suspension if the process is approved.

item.title: Motta cria comissão especial sobre o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta has created a special committee to analyze a constitutional amendment proposal to end the 6×1 work schedule, with 37 titular and 37 substitute members. The committee will discuss reducing the weekly workweek, while two PECs (by Reginaldo Lopes and Erika Hilton) and a government bill from Lula’s administration are simultaneously advancing, proposing 36- or 40-hour workweeks. Motta favors the constitutional amendment route to preserve Legislative leadership, aiming for a floor vote by the end of May.

item.title: Lula deve encerrar mandato sem participar da Agrishow
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will not attend Agrishow 2025 in Ribeirão Preto, with Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and Agriculture Minister André de Paula representing the government instead. The decision, made after a brief internal evaluation on Friday morning (24), reflects a strategy to avoid direct confrontation with the historically Lula-resistant agribusiness sector. Lula has similarly avoided high-profile events like the March for Jesus in previous years, maintaining a low-profile stance on polarizing agendas.

item.title: Moraes decreta prisão domiciliar de condenada do núcleo 2 da trama golpista
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered house arrest for former federal delegate Marília Ferreira de Alencar, sentenced to eight years and six months for her role in the 2022 coup plot. She had already been under preventive house arrest with an electronic ankle monitor and led intelligence analyses in Nucleus 2 that supported Federal Highway Police actions to disrupt voter turnout in Northeastern municipalities. She was convicted of criminal organization and violent abolition of the democratic state, losing her federal police position.

item.title: Clica e Confirma ressalta campanhas do TSE para ampliar participação de jovens eleitores
item.description: The TSE, in partnership with UNICEF Brazil, launched campaigns to encourage youths aged 15 to 17 to obtain their first voter title, aiming to increase youth participation in the 2026 elections. Initiatives include inclusive activities, such as in Sergipe for youths with Down syndrome and in Paraná with students from Alto Piquiri, plus the 'Justice Electoral for All People' event on April 29, focused on accessibility and citizenship.

item.title: Governo bloqueia 28 plataformas de apostas preditivas
item.description: The Brazilian government blocked 28 predictive market platforms, declaring them illegal as they do not fit under betting laws or financial regulations. Economy Minister Dario Durigan announced the decision, citing joint analysis by the Central Bank, CVM, Ministry of Justice, and Anatel, which has already implemented the block. The government warns of financial harm to low-income populations due to lack of oversight and regulatory gaps.

item.title: “STF precisa mudar de nome ou as pessoas que estão lá”, diz Zema
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) harshly criticized the STF, stating it needs to 'change its name or the people who are there', accusing ministers of using their positions for personal enrichment. He argued the Court is acting in a biased and harmful manner to Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Ruas diz que 'respeita a decisão' de Zanin, mas aguarda 'com cautela' a posição final do STF sobre governo do Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL), president of the Rio de Janeiro State Legislative Assembly (Alerj), stated he respects the decision of Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin, who maintained Rio de Janeiro Tribunal of Justice President Ricardo Couto as acting governor, awaiting the final plenary ruling on the state executive succession. Despite his election to lead Alerj, Ruas emphasized that the change in assembly leadership does not automatically alter the legal situation, as the exceptional succession thesis has not yet been analyzed by Minister Luiz Fux. The PL leadership in Rio shows caution, believing there remains room to reverse the decision, as the merits of the ADI will be evaluated by the STF plenary.

item.title: Rio de Janeiro: Zanin mantém desembargador como governador interino
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Rio de Janeiro’s Justice Tribunal President, Judge Ricardo Couto, will remain as interim governor until the court concludes its ruling on the state’s succession process. The decision upholds the April ruling, rejecting the Legislative Assembly’s request for Douglas Ruas (PL) to assume office despite his election as ALERJ president. The ongoing trial will determine whether the next governor is elected by direct popular vote or indirect legislative vote, with the current score at 4-1 in favor of indirect election.

item.title: Deputado aciona TCU para investigar uso de R$ 4,5 mi em acervo privado de Lula
item.description: Federal Deputy Sanderson (PL-RS), vice-leader of the Opposition in the Chamber, filed a representation with the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) to investigate the alleged use of R$ 4.5 million in federal public funds for organizing the private archive of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The action seeks to assess potential irregularities in the allocation of these resources, as referenced in the filing.

item.title: A tentativa de CPI sobre investimentos suspeitos no futebol
item.description: Federal deputy Luciano Amaral (PSD-AL) is gathering signatures for a CPI to investigate national and foreign investors in Brazilian football, citing irregularities in the SAFs of Botafogo and Vasco, as well as Daniel Vorcaro’s investment — owner of Banco Master — in Futebol Forte União (FFU). The initiative suspects the use of professional football as a structure for suspicious or potentially illicit financial operations by investor groups. However, its chances of advancing are minimal due to a backlog of CPIs in the Chamber and the upcoming 2026 elections, which will likely shift lawmakers’ focus.

item.title: “Jeito PT de governar”, diz Ciro ao comentar prejuízo bilionário dos Correios
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) criticized the Lula government by linking the Correios' new billion-dollar loss to the 'PT way of governing', citing recurring failures in state-owned enterprise management. He argued the financial performance reflects a historical pattern of poor administration, reinforcing opposition narratives about inefficiency in public companies under Workers' Party rule.

item.title: Associação de delegados da PF critica fala de Lula sobre agentes que 'fingem trabalhar'
item.description: The Federal Police Delegates Association (ADPF) criticized statements by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who accused PF agents of 'pretending to work'. The association called the remarks unjust and damaging to the institution's image, emphasizing the dedication of its members in combating crime.

item.title: Lula retira lesão do couro cabeludo e deve repousar nos próximos dias
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a surgical procedure on Friday morning (24) in São Paulo to remove a scalp lesion. According to his doctor, Ricardo Kalil, who accompanies the president, the surgery was successful and Lula is expected to rest in the coming days.

item.title: Zanin reforça decisão e mantém presidente do TJ no governo do Rio
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Ricardo Couto de Castro, president of the Rio de Janeiro State Court of Justice, must continue as interim governor until the STF plenary defines the electoral process for the temporary mandate. The decision upholds a prior injunction and rejects a request by newly elected Alerj president Douglas Ruas to assume power, preserving the current arrangement while the succession case following Cláudio Castro's resignation remains stalled due to a request for view.

item.title: Planalto vê como pouco provável ida de Lula a Congresso do PT
item.description: Lula's team says it is 'highly unlikely' he will attend the closing of the PT congress this Sunday (26), due to his recovery from recent head surgery. The assessment was shared by the Planalto press office on Thursday morning (24).

item.title: Novo embate com Trump anima PT, mas traz um risco para Lula e STF
item.description: Lula is again targeting Donald Trump to gain political capital, repeating a strategy that previously boosted his popularity during the U.S. tariff episode. The conflict escalated following the arrest and release of Alexandre Ramagem, a former deputy who sought refuge in the U.S., a situation quickly politicized by both governments. Analysts warn that the U.S. narrative benefits Bolsonaro supporters and that granting political asylum to Ramagem could be seen as a defeat for Lula and the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Associação de delegados critica fala de Lula sobre policiais que ‘fingem trabalhar’
item.description: The Federal Police Delegates Association criticized Lula's remarks about officers who 'pretend to work,' saying they disparage the force and oversimplify public security. The association noted only 53 delegates are assigned to other agencies (under 3% of total), stressing that the real issue is talent loss and declining interest in entrance exams. It argued that fighting organized crime requires investment in training and intelligence, not statements that weaken public discourse.

item.title: “Dinheiro público não é prêmio pra político”, diz Zema
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized on social media X the use of public funds as a privilege for government officials, stating that public money should not be seen as a reward for politicians. Without naming specific individuals or cases, his politically toned post focused on corruption within the public machine and alleged enrichment of public agents.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Lula não terá restrições médicas para campanha após cirurgia | TEMPO REAL
item.description: Lula will face no medical restrictions in actively participating in the 2026 election campaign following his recent surgery. His medical team confirmed he is fit to engage in public activities, including campaign events, travel, and debates, without significant limitations. This removes a potential concern about his ability to run or support candidates in next year's presidential election.

item.title: Campanha de Zema vai parar de postar vídeos satíricos sobre ministros do STF
item.description: The campaign of Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema announced it will stop publishing satirical videos criticizing ministers of the Federal Supreme Court (STF). The decision follows growing criticism over the aggressive and potentially inappropriate tone of such content. The full article is available only to subscribers of the outlet.

item.title: BC barra apostas preditivas sobre eleições, esportes e realities
item.description: The Central Bank banned predictive market operations tied to non-economic events such as elections, sports, and reality shows, stating they resemble unregulated gambling and pose risks of manipulation, money laundering, and threats to event integrity. The measure, part of CMN Resolution No. 5.298, restricts regulated financial trading to assets with economic-financial benchmarks, effectively excluding platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket from operating in Brazil.

item.title: Lula remove lesão causada por carcinoma basocelular; entenda este tipo de câncer de pele
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a procedure this morning to remove a lesion from his scalp, diagnosed as basal cell carcinoma, the most common and least aggressive form of skin cancer. The treatment was performed without complications, and there are no indications of serious health risks at this time.
